data.title: 莱伊 · 沙箱的新角落
data.description: 她把几块小石头挪到沙箱另一边，留出一条干净的通道。沙地兽从沙里探出头，莱伊便停手等它自己过来。
data.action: 整理沙地兽沙箱中的小石头
data.promptProse: Kneeling beside a large wooden terrarium in her cozy living quarters, Ray meticulously arranges smooth river pebbles and dry twigs inside a clean sand enclosure for her pet sandbeast. Warm desk lamp light illuminates the powdery golden sand, fresh succulent treats, and the content little critter nuzzling her hand.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling beside the wooden sand terrarium, she arranges smooth river pebbles in the powdery golden sand while her pet sandbeast nuzzles her hand. Soft warm desk lamplight wraps her cozy quarters in gentle calm.
